result.Method of Attack: Injected obfuscated JavaScript to sniff cryptocurrency wallet requests and replace wallet addresses with attacker-controlled ones via request interception and transaction manipulation
result.Impacted Systems: NPM packages and users interacting with compromised libraries, cryptocurrency wallet interfaces (Ethereum, Bitcoin, Litecoin, Solana, Tron, Bitcoin Cash)
result.Attack Vector: User-side man-in-the-middle style attack via compromised NPM packages injecting malicious code that hooks browser wallet APIs and hijacks network requests
result.Indicators of Compromise: Presence of obfuscated malicious code in index.js of compromised packages, attacker-controlled wallet address lists, interception and modification of fetch() and XMLHttpRequest calls
